resources.string: Permanently erase local data and power off when this credential is entered

"A duress password can be entered instead of the user password anywhere that asks for it, including the lock screen of any user and any user or work profile password prompt.
Submitting the duress password will immediately make the storage contents permanently inaccessible, attempt to delete all eSIMs, and then power off the device. The ROM will remain installed.
The duress PIN works the same way as the duress password."
"Submitting the duress PIN/password instead of the user PIN/password will immediately make the storage contents permanently inaccessible and will attempt to delete all eSIMs."
